data work.ready;
  set work.sample;
  if amount < 0 then delete;
  keep id amount;
run;

proc sql noprint;
  create table work.audit as select id, count(*) as duplicate_count from work.ready group by id having count(*) > 1;
  select count(*) into :repeated trimmed from work.audit;
quit;
%if &repeated ne 0 %then %abort_run(duplicates);

proc sort data=work.ready out=work.ordered;
  by id;
run;
